place_fields.summary: Gaali Mantapa is a historic mantapa within the Chitradurga Fort complex, known as a wind hall and associated with the fort's historic structures.

planning_attributes.legend_or_history: Gaali Mantapa is identified as a historic structure in the Chitradurga Fort complex; the name is associated with wind or breeze passing through the structure.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Reach Chitradurga city and continue to the Chitradurga Fort complex.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: The fort contains uneven stone surfaces and steps; take care while walking through the historic complex.

place_fields.summary: Kamana Bagilu is an entrance gate in the Chitradurga Fort complex and marks the start of the second tier of the fort.

planning_attributes.legend_or_history: Kamana Bagilu is described as the start of the second tier of Chitradurga Fort; the fort is organized into multiple defensive tiers with gateways and passages.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Reach Chitradurga city and continue to Chitradurga Fort; Kamana Bagilu is within the fort complex.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: Expect uneven stone paths and steps within the fort complex.

place_fields.summary: Historical Dhavalihonda is a listed historical place in Kavadigarahatti Layout, Chitradurga, Karnataka.

planning_attributes.description: Historical place listed in Kavadigarahatti Layout, Chitradurga.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: The listed location is Kavadigarahatti Layout in Chitradurga; Chitradurga railway station is reported as the nearest railway station.
